definitions.explanation: The political movement to overthrow the Tokugawa shogunate, particularly in the final years of the Edo period (1860s). A key event leading to the Meiji Restoration.

examples.japanese: {倒幕|とうばく}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The movement to overthrow the shogunate spread.

examples.japanese: {薩摩|さつま}⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{長州|ちょうしゅう}⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倒幕|とうばく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The Satsuma and Choshu domains became the center of the anti-shogunate movement.

examples.japanese: {倒幕|とうばく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧{志士|しし}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Patriots aiming to overthrow the shogunate gathered in Kyoto.

notes:
USAGE:
{倒幕|とうばく} specifically refers to the movement against the Tokugawa shogunate in the 1860s. It is a key term in Japanese history education and historical dramas.

FORMS:
{倒|とう} (to topple) + {幕|ばく} (abbreviation of ⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧, shogunate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倒幕|とうばく}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: anti-shogunate movement
- {倒幕|とうばく}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: anti-shogunate faction
- {倒幕|とうばく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}: anti-shogunate patriots

RELATED WORDS:
The opposite stance was {佐幕|さばく} (support for the shogunate).
